title: Fpqc descent of compatible open subschemes
statement: Let $\{g_i:T_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ be an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. For each $i$, let $W_i\subset T_i$ be an open subscheme. If the pullbacks of $W_i$ and $W_j$ to $T_i\times_S T_j$ are equal for all $i,j$, then there is a unique open subscheme $W\subset S$ whose pullback to every $T_i$ is $W_i$.

proof.text: Construct V = {s | there exist i and x in W_i with g_i(x)=s}. For x in T_i over a point of V, choose its witness y in W_j. The fibre-product point existence lemma [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-points], as realized by Mathlib Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback, gives z over x and y. Compatibility of the projection inverse images then forces x in W_i. The reverse inclusion is immediate using x itself, proving g_i^{-1}(V)=W_i.
The inverse images of V are the given open W_i. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-detects-openness] to make V an open subset and package it as S.Opens.

For uniqueness, use joint surjectivity [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], via the flat jointly-surjective precoverage underlying the fpqc precoverage, to lift any s to a point x of one T_i. The preimage equalities show that s belongs to any candidate descended open exactly when x belongs to W_i. Extensionality of opens proves equality.
